divergences.en_says: two non-member states (the Holy See and the State of Palestine) have been granted this status
divergences.evidence_en: As of 2026, two non-member states (the Holy See and the State of Palestine) have been granted this status

divergences.other_says: granted by UNGA resolution; permanent status based on Assembly practice with no Charter provision
divergences.evidence_other: 옵서버 자격은 유엔 총회 결의에 의해 부여될 수 있다. 상설 옵서버의 지위는 순수하게 총회의 관례에 기초하며, 유엔 헌장에는 이에 대한 규정이 없다.

divergences.other_says: practice distinguishes between state observers and non-state observers
divergences.evidence_other: 관례상 국가 옵서버와 비국가 옵서버를 구분한다.

divergences.other_says: non-member states must be members of one or more specialized agencies to apply for permanent observer status
divergences.evidence_other: 비회원국은 하나 이상의 유엔 전문 기구의 회원이며, 상설 옵서버 국가 지위를 신청할 수 있다.

summary: EN uniquely specifies the two non-member state observers by name and date. KO and FR add procedural details absent from EN: granting via resolution, basis in Assembly practice rather than the Charter, explicit state/non-state distinction, and eligibility requirements for non-member states.
